Synthetic public resume fixtures. All names, contact information and achievements are fictional. TXT is UTF-8. DOCX is a standard deflated OOXML ZIP generated with Python zipfile, with ordinary content types, relationships and WordprocessingML paragraphs. The selectable-text PDF uses Helvetica text operators and a complete cross-reference table. The image-only PDF contains a one-pixel image XObject and no text operators; it exercises the absence of OCR. No personal resume data or external resources are included.
